entry.name: rnbo_zerox_count~
entry.description: The zerox_count~ object detects and reports the total number of zero-crossings in an incoming signal over a specified sample window.

arguments.name: windowSize
arguments.digest: The number of values in each report window
arguments.description: Sets the number of individual values that are sampled for zero-crossings. Once this value is reached, the total number of zero-crossings in the sample-window is output.
